Meta.description: Computer repair, IT support, hardware and websites.

Home.heroText: Computer and laptop service, hardware on order and websites. Track your order status online and get notified by e-mail or WhatsApp.
Home.f1Text: Diagnostics, repair and upgrades of computers, laptops and peripherals.
Home.f2Text: Selection and purchase of hardware and parts tailored to your needs.
Home.f3Text: Design and maintenance of business websites.
Home.trackText: Once we accept your request you can follow the repair status and get notified by e-mail or WhatsApp.

Services.title: Services
Services.intro: Complete IT support for individuals and businesses — from laptop repair to websites.
Services.s1Text: Fault diagnosis, component replacement, power, liquid and physical damage repair.
Services.s2Text: SSD upgrades, RAM expansion, cooling system cleaning and thermal paste replacement.
Services.s3Text: System installation and setup, virus removal, speed-ups, backups.
Services.s4Text: Recovering files from damaged drives, USB sticks and memory cards.
Services.s5Text: Router setup, home and office networks, Wi-Fi coverage, network printers.
Services.s6Text: Selecting and buying computers, laptops, components and accessories to fit your needs and budget.
Services.s7Text: Design, build and maintenance of websites plus help with domains and e-mail.
Services.s8Text: Ongoing support, office equipment service and fast remote help.
Services.ctaText: Request a repair online — we will get back to you with a diagnosis and quote.

About.title: About us
About.lead: suppIT.me is IT service and support built on accurate diagnosis, fair pricing and clear communication.
About.p1: We repair computers and laptops, advise on hardware purchases and build websites. We work with individuals and small businesses.
About.p2: You can track every order online, and we will let you know about status changes by e-mail or WhatsApp — no calling or chasing.
About.v1Text: A quote before the repair and order status available online.
About.v2Text: E-mail and WhatsApp notifications at every step.
About.v3Text: Hardware, software and networks — all in one place.
About.languages: We serve customers in Polish, German and English.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.phoneCountryCodeHint: For numbers entered with a leading 0, e.g. 0151… → +49 151… (49 = Germany, 48 = Poland).
Settings.logoHint: Empty = default suppIT.me logo. An uploaded logo should be readable on light and dark backgrounds.
Settings.metaTemplateHint: Required for messages outside the 24-hour window. Parameters: {{1}} client, {{2}} order no., {{3}} status, {{4}} note; languages: de, pl, en.
Settings.secretsNote: Passwords and tokens are stored encrypted in the database.
Settings.legalIntro: In Germany a business website must have an imprint (§ 5 DDG) and a privacy policy (GDPR). Enter the text in Markdown — ideally prepared or reviewed by a lawyer or generator (e.g. e-recht24). The German version is binding; PL/EN are optional (missing → German version).
Settings.templatesIntro: Text of status change notifications. Empty field = default template. Variables: {{clientName}}, {{orderNumber}}, {{orderTitle}}, {{status}}, {{note}}, {{link}}, {{companyName}}.
Settings.subject: Subject
Settings.templateActive: Send a notification for this status
Settings.whatsappTemplateNote: With a Meta/Twilio template the approved template defines the message — the text below is only used within the 24-hour window.
Settings.passwordHintNew: Leave empty to send an invitation with a link to set the password.
Settings.sendInvite: Send an e-mail with a link to set the password
